parts.name: Left finger — Generalist yellow, mirror of the right
Left handle-gear — black, the left handle: one print with its gear (both hooks, two strap-loop slots, tail fused into the hub), turns on the base’s left post
Right handle-gear — black, the right handle: one print with its gear (both hooks, two strap-loop slots, tail fused into the hub), driven by the pinion, turns on the right post
Pinion — black, centred, full-height teeth, 3 countersunk M3 to the motor flange
Base — black flat plate with a pivot post for each handle-gear, 3 countersunk M3 to the motor
Motor — RobStride RS00, reference only (not printed)
